topic: The conflict between the walk-in customer and the WhatsApp lead

hooks.text: Walk‑in line full, phone buzzing—bot answers while you serve.
Ever lost a sale because you were stuck behind a checkout?
Myth: Bots are cold. Fact: Silence kills more sales.

posts.instagram:
𝗪𝗔𝗟𝗞-𝗜𝗡 𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗘 𝗙𝗨𝗟𝗟, 𝗣𝗛𝗢𝗡𝗘 𝗕𝗨𝗭𝗭𝗜𝗡𝗚—𝗕𝗢𝗧 𝗔𝗡𝗦𝗪𝗘𝗥𝗦 𝗪𝗛𝗜𝗟𝗘 𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗩𝗘
→ ग्राहक सामने खड़ा है, 𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗦𝗔𝗣𝗣 मैसेज ढेर लगे हैं.
→ 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗕𝗢𝗧 बार-बार पूछे जाने वाले सवालों का जवाब देता है.
→ आप स्टोर पर ध्यान दें, बॉट डिजिटल 𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗗𝗦 संभाले.
DM 𝗕𝗢𝗧 और बताएं आपके ग्राहक सबसे ज्यादा क्या पूछते हैं.

posts.linkedin:
Your walk-in client waits while WhatsApp messages keep ringing unanswered.

During busy periods many small businesses juggle a customer at the desk and repeated online questions.

An AI chatbot can answer the same queries automatically, letting you focus on the person in front of you.

It also works overnight, helping reduce the time messages sit unanswered.

You can add a simple chatbot to your existing WhatsApp number without stopping any face‑to‑face service.

Message BOT to see if this fits your business.
posts.bluesky: 𝗪𝗔𝗟𝗞-𝗜𝗡 𝘃𝘀 𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧𝗦𝗔𝗣𝗣 — you can't serve the customer in front of you and answer every ping at once. A chatbot handles the digital queue while you handle the physical one. DM BOT for an honest take on whether it fits your business.

replies.reply: Thanks for asking. I build AI chatbots that answer common questions and capture WhatsApp enquiries. Quick question: what do you want customers to do, call, WhatsApp, or fill a form? Based on that, chatbot pricing is INR 2,999 or INR 4,999 plus INR 299 per month maintenance, and you pay only after you approve the work. Prefer a quick WhatsApp chat or details here?

replies.if_they_say: do you do this for my kind of business?
replies.reply: I work with any small business that talks to customers, shops, clinics, studios, or service providers. What do you sell, and what is the one question your customers ask most?
Yes, it replies even when you are closed or busy with walk-in customers. It captures the enquiry and lets you reply when you can. DM BOT and tell me what your customers ask most.
